input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Bet #1 PayApps: backup packet (application + PDF/photo backup in one PDF)

errors.what: Built the full backup packet (private PR 93, ~1,100 lines) that a parallel run landed first as private PR 92; closed unmerged as a duplicate.
errors.cost: most of the run's build time

errors.what: PNG tRNS chunk dropped by a string replace that missed the line's '} else if' prefix; caught by the real-file render (black background) and a new test.

doc_friction.issue: Searching PRs once at the start does not prevent duplicates on PayApps, where many runs share the ROADMAP 'Next' list per hour: PR 92 opened ~15 min after my check. Suggest: open a draft PR naming the item immediately after picking it, and re-check open+merged PRs before large builds.
private-monorepo Actions jobs fail in 3-10 s with no downloadable logs (PRs 90, 92, 93, 94); not covered by the CI-starvation note, and ci_starvation.py targets the public repo.

deviations.why: Merged private PR 94 on local verification because private CI runners never started (same as PRs 90 and 92).
deviations.did: Ran pdf-merge unit tests, packet worker tests, typecheck, biome, site tests and builds locally; listed them in the PR body.

deviations.why: No new blog post: the shipped change is a security fix plus a site line, and the backup packet itself was shipped by another run, which owns its write-up.

notes: Security queue empty (exit 3); ideas inbox empty. Routed ventures/2, top bet PayApps. private-monorepo attached via add_repo and cloned first try. Own packet implementation verified on 6 PDF producers + JPEG/PNG (72 pages, poppler clean), unit 324/324 and worker 207/207 green, then found PR 92 already merged. Ran my hostile-input ideas against PR 92's reader: object-stream header loop ran to /N on empty tokens (Number('')===0); 74 s on a 1 KB file in the unit test. Fixed + tested in PR 94 (merged): pdf-merge 15/15, packet worker 4/4, typecheck, biome, site 21/21. Site lists the packet as built and drops stale 'per-line retainage' from next.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: DoS diagnosis+fix+test ~1h, plus a dependency-free PDF merge prototype later discarded ~5h

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
